method.target: Median observed ADS-B ground-speed/time mileage by airport pair
method.geometry: Current displayed 12-circle radial and anchored longitude-warped flat disk
method.predictor: Four nearest training route examples in standardized four-feature space; inverse-distance weighted geometric mean of observed mileage-per-chord ratios
method.trainingQualityFilter: At least three accepted flights and (p90TrackKm - p10TrackKm) / medianTrackKm <= 0.60

excludedTrainingRoutes.reason: p90/p10 spread relative to median exceeds 0.60; one observed flight is a strong mileage outlier

importantLimitations: The supported accuracy figures apply only to held-out routes within the route-feature and chord-length support radius.
Two of six independent holdout pairs are outside support and are not included in the supported holdout error metrics.
No qualifying training airport-pair chord exceeds about 2,314 km; Santiago–Canberra has a displayed chord of about 23,894 km and is therefore an extrapolation.
This is a typical observed flight-mileage estimate, not a selected flight's path or a shortest point-to-point distance.
